Requires a qualifying smart thermostat connected to central air conditioning.

steps: Confirm you're an Xcel Energy Colorado residential customer with a single-family premises, central AC, and a qualifying smart thermostat.
Enroll your thermostat in AC Rewards on the Xcel Energy Colorado page.
Allow small automatic adjustments during peak events (you can usually override them).
Receive your $100 one-time enrollment bill credit.
timing: Enrollment credit on sign-up; $25 annual credit while enrolled.
